description: Complete the outcome bid: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_outcome_bid UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to POST /labor/outcome-bids, the same public door any HTTP client uses; this server holds no keys and no funds. Free with a valid signature. Returns the recorded bid; the packets' creator accepts it or lets it lapse, and outcome_bid_status shows which.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_outcome_bid, unchanged.
